items.title: Wells Fargo, Cisco, Intuit Among 6 More Companies Objecting to Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Twenty-two companies have now objected to having their shares traded on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, after Wells Fargo, Cisco, Marvell, Arm, Moderna.

items.title: Keystone customers say breach exposed data the hardware wallet maker promised to delete
items.summary: Keystone has said it deletes customer information 180 days after their orders in most cases, though X users have cast doubt on that claim.

items.title: ECB official sees digital euro as key to protecting EU ‘sovereignty’
items.summary: Piero Cipollone said the bloc is on track to test real transactions in 2027 and roll out a digital euro as early as 2029, pending legislation this year.

items.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
items.summary: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.
